race.comment: EMPRESS ASPEN (2) has been plying her trade in town this campaign and will find this assignment much more to her liking. Looks ready for the step-up in trip now and is sure to prove very tough to hold out. CAITLIN (4) boasts a win around this circuit and maps nicely for this from gate two. Can give backers a sight up on speed. SHOT DOWN BY LOVE (6) hit the frame here in an improved performance last time out and will be rock-hard fit for this. In the mix. LIVEWIRE LASS (8) is better than recent efforts suggest and can feature if she brings her A-game. SEALORD (1) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be underestimated.
